story_review.one_viewing_summary: Code-scope chain at desk height. Scrub-sleeved arms type, then the right hand rides the question card in one continuous push and releases it to glide into the OpenEvidence AI tool beside the propped chart. One answer slides out under the tool face toward the lens, and three citations tuck into its Sources slot. Dated tags pin to the boundary. A masked sign-in opens the lock in the same shot. The citations cascade with every tab clear and literature and guidelines lift. Clinician tokens light past half, labelled as UTMB's own report. 'Not in release' tags clip onto the answer, the Accuracy slot lights and pulses empty, and the use-and-experience tag pins to the share.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening asks what comes back when a UTMB clinician asks inside the record. The ending holds that same answer beside the chart: its Sources slot glows full, its Accuracy ring pulses empty, its limit tags are clear of the keyboard, and the use-and-experience tag stays on the share. This answers the question within c4, c5 and c8 without claiming any outcome.
story_review.weakest_transition: s6-shot-1 to s6-shot-2 at 29.0 s: the cut from the report tag on the share to a close on the answer clip crops most of the answer card. The tags read before the viewer is shown which card they hang from.

risks_for_the_phone_critic: Hand credibility at phone size. At peak push reach (s1 about 0.96-1.2 s) the forearm's local length grows about 26%, from about 480 to 605 local units, while the upper arm stays within about 3%. Judge whether this reads as perspective or as a stretched limb.
s6-shot-2 crops most of the answer card and its Accuracy slot off the right edge; check that the tags read as hanging from the answer.

The share board sits behind the record boundary and chart. At the s5 detail and s6-shot-1 (scale 2.05) the chart tabs and the boundary's glowing edge cross the first column of tokens, the left end of the bar and the pin end of the report tag. The depth order is correct, but check the clutter.
The evaluating-tag string runs diagonally across the end of 'decision support' in s8-shot-1, about 2.6 px wide on screen.
The hands are removed at the s3-to-s4 cut, and later world shots show an unattended keyboard.
Card shear (lower edges shifted left) runs against the desk grain lines to the right of about x 243; check the perspective at phone size.
Motion feel of the released card gliding about 200 px into the tool after the hand slows, and of the answer emerging below the tool face.
stronger_treatment: b. Every declared cut changes the picture substantially. The opening is a close on hands and card, the hand performs the send as one continuous push, and the return is a medium shot with 'Answer' and 'Sources' at about 31 px. The s4 cascade keeps every tab clear, and the share and closing shots have their own desk-level cameras.
